projects.title: Firstboard Website | Regional OOH Advertising Platform
projects.description: Website helps advertisers discover billboard and digital out-of-home media across Southeast Asia and connect with the team to plan campaigns. I coordinated website improvements across country teams, developers, and content writers, translating business needs into clear requirements and testing new features before release. My work also covered content planning, SEO, media listing accuracy, and lead generation, with a focus on making it easier for advertisers to find suitable locations and submit enquiries.

projects.title: T-Outdoor Website Development
projects.description: I developed and deployed a responsive website redesign for T-Outdoor, a Malaysian outdoor advertising company. I built the Home, About, and Contact pages, organised the site’s content and visual assets, and implemented an enquiry form. I tested the site on a staging subdomain before its planned move to the main website, with a focus on making T-Outdoor’s services clear and helping potential clients get in touch.
